entry.name: favorites
entry.label: Default pinned apps, used once when the pinned list is empty. Each entry is a desktop id, a preferred:// URL or several alternatives separated by '|' (the first installed one is pinned).

entry.name: favoritesPortedToKAstats
entry.label: Whether the default pinned apps were written to the shared KActivities store

entry.name: favoritesClientId
entry.label: KActivities client id of the pinned list. Every launcher instance with the same id shares its pins.

entry.name: designLabels
entry.label: Show the short design names (Files, Browser, Terminal...) on the pinned tiles of the default apps

entry.name: buttonStyle
entry.label: Panel button: auto (tile in a tall panel, pill in a thin panel), icon (logo only) or hidden (zero size; open with Meta or D-Bus)

entry.name: dimBackground
entry.label: Dim the desktop behind the open launcher

entry.name: bottomOffset
entry.label: Distance in logical pixels between the bottom screen edge and the bottom of the launcher card (dock height + gap) when no panel reserves that space

entry.name: showRecommended
entry.label: Show recently used files under the pinned apps

entry.name: openRequest
entry.label: Written by other shell parts through desktop scripting: "search:NONCE" or "apps:NONCE" opens the launcher in that mode
